answer: Miscellaneous >> Others Question ID: 160891 Country: India Title: Is my dad's elder brother’s wife that is my aunty a mahram or non mahram for me? Question: Is my dad's elder brother’s wife that is my aunty a mahram or non mahram for me? Answer ID: 160891 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1036/819/SD=8/1439) The wife of your father’s elder brother is not a mahram for you. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
